content.title: India's Zoomcar to launch cab rental product to test demand in larger market
content.summary: Zoomcar will launch a chauffeur-driven cab rental product in the southern Indian city of Bengaluru as it looks to test the waters in a larger part of the transportation market, the self-drive car-sharing platform told Reuters on Friday.  The move comes months after the cash-strapped company terminated co-founder Greg Moran as CEO after an over a decade-long tenure at the helm that saw the firm go public in the United States.  Zoomcar could face stiff competition in a market dominated by well-heeled players like Ola and Uber that primarily offer intra-city ride-hailing services, but also offer cab rentals.
